I found Cobalt Labs's invoices, but there are **two approved invoices**, not one:

| Invoice | Amount | Due date |
|---|---|---|
| INV-15523 | $7,693.96 | 2026-11-25 |
| INV-89190 | $3,526.06 | 2026-11-04 |

(There's also a paid invoice INV-26154 and a draft INV-28385, so those aren't in play.)

Since you asked me to pay "the approved invoice" exactly once, and paying the wrong one (or an extra one) would be a real payment to a vendor, I don't want to guess. Could you confirm:

1. **Which invoice** to pay — INV-15523, INV-89190, or both? and
2. I'll send it by **wire** from the operating account (falling back to ACH if wire isn't available), exactly once.

If you'd like, I can pay both approved invoices in full in a single pass — just say "both" and I'll proceed.
